How do I ping this check?

Have your job call the URL above when it runs — a plain GET or POST reports success. Add a suffix for other signals:

SignalURLEffect
successhttp://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627marks the check up
failhttp://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627/failmarks the check down
starthttp://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627/startopens a run so an overrun can be caught
loghttp://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627/logrecords a note, status unchanged
exit codehttp://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627/<code>0 = up, anything else = down
shell examples# report success when the job finishes curl -fsS http://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627 # wrap a job: start it, run, then report the exit code curl -fsS http://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627/start mybackup.sh curl -fsS http://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627/$? # report failure and attach the output (shown in Recent pings) mybackup.sh 2>&1 | curl -fsS --data-binary @- http://localhost:18080/ping/f009852c-3f49-4586-9204-207afa2c1627/fail
oldersolid = timed run, taller = longer · hollow = duration not measurable · amber ≥80% budget · red = failednow
